status_note: Pilot Baseline (N=2 drives, 1.0 gal total) — Too few points for statistical trend testing yet. Continuing monthly collection to build a long-term dataset.

sources: U.S. Census Bureau QuickFacts / ACS: Official household counts & household sizes across all 25 Texas cities
U.S. EPA: Fats, Oils, and Grease (FOG) account for ~47% of reported municipal sewer blockages, causing Sanitary Sewer Overflows
NREL (National Renewable Energy Laboratory): ~9 lbs of used cooking oil/grease generated per person/year in metro areas (~7.5 lbs/gal)
Defend Your Drains North Texas (NCTCOG): Regional Holiday Grease Roundup intercepts 8,500+ gallons in a single season

outreach_highlights: 2 pilot waste cooking oil collection drives in Frisco, TX (1.0 gallon collected)
